response.justification: Bogdan possesses over 15 years of software development experience with a strong technical background in developer tooling, testing infrastructure, and mobile platforms. However, the resume lacks any evidence of formal people management experience (such as conducting one-on-ones, performance management, or organizational leadership), which is a core requirement for this mid-to-senior Engineering Manager position.
strengths: Extensive 15+ years of software development experience across various stacks and platforms.
Demonstrated experience in engineering productivity, having built testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tools.
Hands-on mobile platform development experience (iOS/Apple TV), aligning well with the target ecosystem.
concerns: No explicitly stated experience in formal people management (e.g., performance reviews, 1-on-1s, hiring).
Lacks demonstrated experience in leading organizational change or managing mid-to-senior level engineering teams.
Career trajectory has remained heavily focused on individual contributor (IC) roles rather than transitioning into management.
